settings.heading: What a home sauna costs to run
settings.intro_fact: An 8 kW traditional room run three 45-minute sessions a week uses 936 kWh a year — $172 at the US average rate, $277 in Massachusetts, $123 in Nevada. Your ZIP decides which. For 92 of our 139 priced saunas the manufacturer publishes no rated power, and we say so rather than estimating.
settings.collection_label: Traditional saunas, with their stated kW where there is one
settings.dataset_name: InHouse Wellness home sauna cost tables
settings.dataset_description: Purchase price, delivery tier, rated power and state electricity rate for 139 priced home saunas, each figure carrying its source and fetch date. Rated power is present for 47; the remaining 92 are recorded as absent rather than estimated.
